name: 95519 · Mckinleyville, CA
findings: ZIP 95519 (Mckinleyville) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95519 (Mckinleyville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95519 (Mckinleyville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
